articles.headline: AFC president unclear on backing for Infantino's FIFA reelection
articles.description: The president of the AFC gave no hint Thursday about the body's support or opposition to the reelection of Gianni Infantino as FIFA president.

articles.headline: Infantino apologized, but reelection as FIFA president remains far from certain
